cards.ruleText:
Your Onset — If you have the most cards in your Grave,
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Stare... Stare until your eyes adjust to the madness."

Gouge

Intimidate
Whenever a Pest Character you control deals Battle damage to a player, that player Grinds 2.
cards.flavor: "I speak for the rats... and they told me they want in your skin."

Gouge

(Airborne — This Character can only be blocked by other Characters with Airborne.)

cards.flavor: "Spiraling into depression."

Arrive — Put a Gouge counter on target Character.

Gouge

cards.name: Corpus Fracture

Additional Cost: Banish a Character from your Grave.
Destroy target Character with Mana Cost less than the Banished cards’s Mana Cost used for the additional cost.

cards.name: Anxious Feeling
cards.ruleText:
Imbue Player
Cursed Player’s Onset — Cursed player Grinds 1.
cards.flavor: "I feel like I’m being watched."

cards.name: Gloom Walker
cards.ruleText:
Gouge, Shade
Whenever you play a Curse card, each opponent Grinds equal to that card’s Mana Cost.

cards.name: Inkling Doubt
cards.ruleText: This turn, whenever a Character you control with Shade causes an opponent to Grind any number of cards, Draw 1.

cards.name: Paraswarmia
cards.ruleText:
Airborne, Gouge 2
(Gouge 2 — Whenever this card deals damage to a player, that player Grinds 2 times that many cards.)
cards.flavor: "Much worse than paranoia."

cards.name: Scuttling Scour
cards.ruleText:
Each Onset — The active player Grinds 1.
(Each Onset — At the start of each turn, ...)

Shade, Gouge

cards.name: Squealing Pulp
cards.ruleText:
Gouge, Barrier — Grind 5
(Gouge — Whenever this card deals damage to a player, that player Grinds that many cards.)

cards.ruleText:
Lethal
{L}: Deal 1 damage to any target.
(Lethal — Whenever this card deals damage to a Character, destroy that Character.)

cards.name: Devil’s Deal
cards.ruleText:
Your Onset —
Draw 1 and lose 1 Life.
(Your Onset — At the start of your turn, ...)
cards.flavor: "It’s a life long commitment."

cards.name: Veracious Pitdweller
cards.ruleText:
Your Onset — Sacrifice a Character.
(Your Onset — At the start of your turn, ...)
cards.flavor: "IT HUNGERS FOR MOOOORREEE!!!"

cards.name: Fallen Slicer
cards.ruleText:
Airborne
Arrive — Choose an opponent, they choose to make you sacrifice a Character or pay 6 Life.

cards.name: Noxious Circle Mage

Whenever a Character dies, each player loses 1 Life.

cards.name: Occult Burst

Additional Cost: Sacrifice a Necro, Undead, or Vampire Character.
Destroy target Character with Mana Cost less than the sacrificed Character’s Arcane or Mana Cost.

cards.name: Piercing Ligament
cards.ruleText:
Additional Cost: Pay X Life.
Destroy target Character with Mana Cost X or less.

cards.name: Risen Gravemass
cards.ruleText:
Lethal
Demise — Put a -1 counter on each Character dealt damage by this card this turn.
(Lethal — Whenever this card deals damage to a Character, destroy that Character.)

cards.name: Reave
cards.ruleText:
Additional Cost: Pay 3 Life.
Destroy target Character.

cards.name: Reconstructing Mass
cards.ruleText:
Demise — You may pay {VV2}. If you do, Revive this card, it Arrives Locked.
(Demise — When this card is destroyed and put into the Grave, ...)

cards.name: Soul Swayer
cards.ruleText: Whenever you play a Necro or Undead card, each opponent loses 1 Life.
cards.flavor: "Weavers are adept in soul magic. It’s up to them how they use it."

cards.name: Bounding Goliath
cards.ruleText:
Sacrifice a Character: This card gains Airborne this turn. Gain 1 Life.
(Airborne — This Character can only be blocked by other Characters with Airborne.)

cards.name: Egotistic Weaver
cards.ruleText:
Depleted, Thaumaturge
Whenever a Necro or Undead Character dies, gain 1 Life.
(Depleted — This card cannot be Crystallized.)

cards.name: Grave Colossus
cards.ruleText: * is equal to the number of Undead and Necro cards in your Grave.
cards.flavor: "Bodies are easy to raise... But a whole graveyard?"

cards.name: Lurking Shadow
cards.ruleText:
Shade, Lethal
(Shade — This card can't be blocked by or block other Characters unless they also have Shade and can't be targeted by cards or abilities (including your own).)

cards.name: Vitrifying Skeleton
cards.ruleText: Revive: {V2}, it Arrives Locked.
cards.flavor: "Each time a bone breaks, a glassy substance fills the gaps. This really is one of my greatest creations!"

cards.name: Xylex’s Touched
cards.ruleText:
Lethal
Whenever this card deals damage to a Character with Arcane, deal X damage to that cards controller, where X is that card’s Arcane.

cards.name: Decapheli Remnant
cards.ruleText:
Absolute, Invulnerable
Each other Field Card you control gains Invulnerable.
(Invulnerable — This card cannot be destroyed due to damage or Non-Rendering effects.)

cards.name: Josephine of Heart
cards.ruleText:
Unique, Sustain 2
Your Onset — Gain Life equal to the total Arcane among Yellow Field Cards you control.
cards.flavor: "She who wishes to secure the good of others has already secured her own."

cards.name: Achieve Clarity
cards.ruleText: Your Offset — Gain Life equal to target Character you control’s Health or Arcane.
cards.flavor: "Clarity comes from knowing who you are."

cards.name: Banish the Mighty
cards.ruleText: Banish target Character with Attack 5 or greater.
cards.flavor:
In the face of overwhelming power,
For in our heart and our deeds,
We know the power of the just shall prevail.
— Vangaurd Oath

cards.name: Daily Devotions
cards.ruleText:
Each Offset — If you’ve gained 3 or more Life this turn, Draw 1.
(Each Offset — At the end of each turn, ...)

cards.name: Sunspired Healer
cards.ruleText:
Sustain
{Y}, {L}: Heal target Character.
(Heal — The next time this card would be destroyed or dealt damage this turn, instead don't. If it's in Battle, remove it from Battle and Lock it.)

cards.name: Prism Warden
cards.ruleText:
Immune to cards that are a color among Color counters on this card
Arrive — Put a Color counter of your choice on target Field Card.
cards.flavor: "Refractions of belief help me solidify my own."

cards.name: Castle Guard
cards.ruleText:
Guardian, Fortify
Demise — Draw 1.
(Guardian — This card can't attack.)
cards.flavor: "He always kept watch over the Queen. From when she came for breakfast, till she left for dinner."

cards.name: Endure the Battle
cards.ruleText: Destroy target attacking Character. Gain Life equal to its Attack.
cards.flavor: "I know help will come."

cards.name: Holdfast
cards.ruleText:
Target Character gains Invulnerable this turn.
(Invulnerable — This card cannot be destroyed due to damage or Non-Rendering effects.)

cards.name: Paladin Devotee
cards.ruleText:
Sustain, Steadfast
(Steadfast — This Character can block if it's Locked. Sustain — Whenever this card deals damage, you gain that much Life.)

cards.name: Stall for Time
cards.ruleText:
Put a Seal counter on each attacking or blocking Character.
(Seal counter — Any Field Card with a Seal counter can’t activate abilities, have abilities trigger, attack, block, or Unlock. Each Onset the active player removes a Seal counter from each card they control.)

cards.name: Towering Vanguard
cards.ruleText:
Fortify
(Fortify — {Y}: This Character gains +1 Health this turn.)
cards.flavor: "Giants of Old wander, looking for a place to fit in."

cards.name: Arcane Proctor Estella
cards.ruleText:
Unique
Lock a Wizard Character with less than or equal to this card’s Arcane: Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Rumors surrounded her, even after all this time teaching at the academy. Some think there’s more to her past, or perhaps students just like to talk."

cards.name: Arcane Dean Hollshire
cards.ruleText:
Thaumaturge, Steadfast
Arrive — Draw 1.
Whenever a Wizard Character Arrives under your control, choose 1
— Put a Thaumaturge counter on it.
— Put a Steadfast counter on it.
— Put an Impede counter on it, and Draw 1.

cards.name: Walking Glacier
cards.ruleText:
Raid — Put an Impede counter on each Character the blocking player controls.
(Raid — Whenever this card deals Battle damage to a player, ...)
cards.flavor: "Wild elementals are quiet the sight."

cards.name: Chilling Cloudform
cards.ruleText:
Airborne
Raid — Put an Impede counter on target Character the blocking player controls.
(Airborne — This Character can only be blocked by other Characters with Airborne.)

cards.name: Library Lesson
cards.ruleText: Draw cards equal to target Character’s Arcane you control.
cards.flavor: "Estella has been a teacher at the academy for decades... but only teaches a select few."

cards.name: Flash Freeze
cards.ruleText: Put an Impede counter on each Character.

cards.name: Mage Meddling
cards.ruleText:
Cancel target Non-Character card.
You may Lock a Wizard Character you control and pay {1}. If you do, Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "That’s funny, but this is a lot more funny..."

cards.name: Sage Scrying
cards.ruleText: Cancel target card, Foretell equal to that card’s Mana Cost.
cards.flavor: "The scrying pools show visions of unease."

cards.name: Skewed Vision
cards.ruleText:
Illusion, Barrier {2}
(Illusion — Whenever this card is successfully targeted by a card or ability its controller sacrifices it.)
cards.flavor: "Illusions can seem so detailed, but when you find out it wasn’t there you wonder how it felt so real."

cards.name: Thought Scour Sage
cards.ruleText:
Thaumaturge
Your Onset — Foretell.
cards.flavor: "Some study magic for their whole life, while others are naturally gifted by the arcane. Most mindmages show affinity from a young age, but that doesn’t stop some from learning it anway."

cards.name: Azure Aspirant
cards.ruleText:
Thaumaturge, Barrier {2}
(Barrier — This card can’t be targeted by cards or abilities you opponents control unless the controller of that card or ability pays {2}.)

cards.name: Creeping Frost
cards.ruleText: Your Onset — You may Lock a Blue Character you control. If you do, put an Impede counter on any target Field Card.

cards.name: Mind Bender
cards.ruleText: Your Onset — Put a Barrier {2} counter on another target Blue Character you control.
cards.flavor: "Esper mages run black market schemes, the more experienced mages can make you vanish from all the minds of peopler who have it out for you."

cards.name: Mind Mitigator
cards.ruleText: Opponents play with their Hand revealed.
cards.flavor: "Esper magic blurs the line between mind and reality. Projecting your thoughts is novice mind magic... But projecting other’s thoughts."

cards.name: Novice Thought Mage
cards.ruleText:
Thaumaturge
(Thaumaturge — This Character can only be blocked by Characters with Arcane, if this Character is blocked, compare each Character’s Arcane and destroy the one with less Arcane. If not, this Character deals Battle damage equal to its Arcane.)

cards.name: Subterfuge
cards.ruleText: Cancel target card unless its control pays {X}, where X is the greatest Arcane among Characters you control.
cards.flavor: "Sometimes you can’t stop magic, but distracting them long enough works just as well."

cards.name: Sync Caster
cards.ruleText: Your Onset — Lock any number of Wizard Characters you control, Foretell equal to the number of cards Locked this way.

cards.name: Furnace Master Malle
cards.ruleText:
Firebreathing
If a Red source you control would deal Non-Battle damage to a player, instead it deals double that much damage.
cards.flavor: "Don’t let the fire burn you."

cards.name: Rolling Coals
cards.ruleText: Characters you control gain Firebreathing, Overwhelm, and Intimidate this turn.
cards.flavor: "The Crimson Knight mages would cast burning coals alongside their troops cause chaos on the battlefield."

cards.name: Whelpling Flame Dragon
cards.ruleText:
Airborne, Firebreathing
(Airborne — This Character can only be blocked by other Characters with Airborne.)
(Firebreathing — {R}: This Character gains +1 Attack this turn.)
cards.flavor: "Even as much damage as that thing causes, it's still only a baby."

cards.name: Barbaric Carver
cards.ruleText:
Bloodlust, Fury
(Fury — This Character deals Battle damage before each other Character without Fury during the Battle Damage Phase.)

cards.name: Crag Fire Giant
cards.ruleText:
Firebreathing
Demise — Deal 1 damage to each Character.
(Firebreathing — {R}: This Character gains +1 Attack this turn.)

cards.name: Ember Evocation
cards.flavor: "Words only uttered in the hearth of a Mortuary fire."

cards.name: Fohh-Clan Carver
cards.ruleText:
Overwhelm
Other Giant Characters you control gain +1 Attack.
(Overwhelm — This card deals excess damage to the controller of the card it’s dealing damage to.)

cards.name: Stab the Heart
cards.ruleText:
Target Character you control gains Fury and +1 Attack this turn.
(Fury — This Character deals Battle damage before each other Character without Fury during the Battle damage phase.)

cards.name: Twin Blade Marauder
cards.ruleText:
Volley
(Volley — This Character deals Battle damage an additional time during the Battle damage phase.)
cards.flavor: "I have found that fancy titles mean nothing when it comes to fighting."

cards.name: Warblade Extraordinaire
cards.ruleText:
Volley
Battlecry — This card gains +1 Attack for each other attacking Warrior.
cards.flavor: "The warriors around him helped showcase just how much better he was.."

cards.name: Wild Band Mutt
cards.ruleText: Whenever a Character blocks an attacking Character you control, deal 1 damage to that blocking Character.
cards.flavor: "Awe shit, he bit my finger off!" — 7 Fingered Joe

cards.name: Adept Firebolt
cards.ruleText:
Deal 3 damage to any target.
If you've played another Pyro card this turn, instead deal 4 damage.

cards.name: Giant Fireblast
cards.ruleText:
Overwhelm
Deal 5 damage to target Character.
(Overwhelm — This card deals excess damage to the controller of the card it’s dealing damage to.)

cards.name: Kettle Fueler
cards.ruleText:
Firebreathing
Sacrifice, {L}: Create {RR}.
(Firebreathing — {R}: This Character gains +1 Attack this turn.)
cards.flavor: "Witches use elementals to keep cauldrons warm, but using them to set stuff on fire works too."

cards.name: Furiadept Mage
cards.ruleText: Whenever you play a Pyro Spell, deal 1 damage to target player.
cards.flavor: "Fire mages are as old as magic itself. Learning how the world burms in so many beautiful ways. But all that aside, some just want to watch the world burn."

cards.name: Reckless Cohort
cards.ruleText:
Bloodlust, Fury
(Bloodlust — This Character must attack each Battle if able.)
cards.flavor: "He even makes me look a little less mad... But just a little." — Fingerless Joe

cards.name: Strike Fast
cards.ruleText:
Target Character gains Swift this turn. If it’s a Warrior it also gains +1 Attack this turn.
(Swift — This Character can attack and activate Lock abilities the turn it's played.)

cards.name: Sulphuric Vapors
cards.flavor: "Alchemists seek to discover the intricacies of the Periodic Cube, however not all discoveries are for the best."

cards.name: Warmachine Auger
cards.ruleText:
Whenever this card attacks, it gains +1 for each other attacking Character you control.
Whenever this card blocks, it gains +1 for each other blocking Character you control.

cards.name: Weaponry Specialist
cards.ruleText: The first Armament or Soldier card you play each turn costs {1} less.
cards.flavor: "Always keep your men armed, and they’ll always protect you."

cards.name: Bronze Forge Smith
cards.ruleText: {1}, {L}: Put a +1 counter on target Object.
cards.flavor: "Stout artisans fine tune their craft over their life. Each Stout usually taking a specialty involving their metallurgy. Bronze Stout like engineering as it’s robust in contraptions."

cards.name: Captain’s Confront
cards.ruleText: Target Character you control gains +X this turn, where X is the number of Characters you control.
cards.flavor: "Lead by example."

cards.name: Commander’s Authority
cards.ruleText:
Choose target Hero Character you control, then choose 1
— Characters you control gain +X Attack where X is the chosen card’s Attack.
— Characters you control gain +X Health where X is the chosen card’s Health.

cards.name: Dual Front Attack
cards.ruleText: Attacking and blocking Characters you control gain Volley this turn.
cards.flavor: "All of you! CHARGE!"

cards.name: Pincer Attack
cards.ruleText: Destroy target Character blocking or being blocked by a Soldier Character you control.

cards.name: Rally Captain's Blade
cards.ruleText:
Armed Character gains +1 for each Character you control.
Arm: {3}
cards.flavor: "There are many militant forces across the lands, each serving different powers. But all of them would fall apart without the leadership of their generals."

cards.name: Rally the Squadron
cards.ruleText: Soldiers you control gain +1 until your next turn.

cards.name: Rising Major
cards.ruleText: Other Characters you control gain +1 for each +1 counter on this card.

cards.name: Sigil Banner
cards.ruleText:
As long as Armed Character is Locked, other Characters you control
gain +1 Attack.
As long as Armed Character is Unlocked, other Characters you control gain +1 Health
Arm: {1}

cards.name: Artillery Automata
cards.ruleText:
Volley 2, Snare
(Volley 2— This Character deals Battle damage 2 additional times during the Battle damage phase.)
(Snare — This Character may block Characters with Airborne.)

cards.name: Foot Archers
cards.ruleText:
Volley, Snare
(Volley— This Character deals Battle damage an additional time during the Battle damage phase.)
(Snare — This Character may block Characters with Airborne.)

cards.name: Squad Leader
cards.ruleText: Other Soldier Characters you control gain +1.
cards.flavor:
"Stand in the face of death, and march backwards
INTO HELL!"

cards.name: Squadron Mascot
cards.ruleText: Arrive — Soldier Characters you control gains +1 until your next turn.
cards.flavor: "Winston loved to run up and down the barracks, it was an honor when he got to run one last time with his friends."

cards.name: Upper Ranked Arms
cards.flavor:
"The Crimson Knights are more than soldiers; they are legends forged in blood and fire.
Clad in darkened steel, only the worthy may bear the crimson armor.
The Crimson Knights serve neither crown nor gold, only the betterment of their battalion.
Marching with them means to march for the honor bound craft of your sword and skill."

cards.name: Hearth Warden
cards.ruleText:
You may Crystallize cards from your Grave.
You may Crystallize an additional time each turn.
cards.flavor: "He was there when the first elves were chosen, and he was there when the first elves fell."

cards.name: Beast of Burden
cards.ruleText: * is equal to the number of Characters you control.
cards.flavor:
Through valleys deep and mountains high,
They trudge beneath a sprawling sky.
Their silent strength, the field they lace,
In every step, a tireless pace.

cards.name: Wild Rush
cards.ruleText:
Characters you control gain +3 Attack and Overwhelm this turn.
(Overwhelm — This card deals excess damage to the controller of the card it’s dealing damage to.)

cards.name: Olden Rhinodon
cards.flavor: "The grove has watched over him for years."

cards.name: Final Grove Tender
cards.ruleText: Arrive — Recover a Green Character.
cards.flavor:
By moonlight’s glow and the sun’s last ray,
We bless this ground where they gently lay.
With roots entwined and whisper soft,
Their essence rises, carried aloft.

cards.name: Gila Gargant
cards.ruleText:
Overwhelm
(Overwhelm — This card deals excess damage to the controller of the card it’s dealing damage to.)
cards.flavor: "This valley is infamous for it’s gaint fauna, I like the lizards back at home more."

cards.name: Cifera Locus
cards.ruleText: Create X{G}, where X is the total Arcane among Characters you control.
cards.flavor: "Ancient elf magic held only in the most devoted druid covens."

cards.name: Hilltop Hibernator
cards.ruleText: You can only play this card if you've Crystallized 2 or more cards this turn.
cards.flavor: "They are covered in a thick, mossy hide that makes them blend into the wilderness. They like to sleep on the hilltops to stay aware of their surroundings."

cards.name: Mature Arthropod
cards.ruleText:
Arrive — Put either a +1 or Overwhelm counter on this card.
(Overwhelm — This card deals excess damage to the controller of the card it’s dealing damage to.)

cards.name: Nature's Toll
cards.ruleText:
Only play this card if you control 3 or more Wild Field Cards.
Destroy target Object or Ongoing Spell.

cards.name: Spin Essence
cards.ruleText: You may Crystallize an additional time this turn.
cards.flavor: "Life itself has many gifts to give, but to be able to bend the essence of life itself is other worldly."

cards.name: Wild Form Druid
cards.ruleText: Arrive — Lock any number of Beast Characters you control, put a +1 counter on this card for each card Locked this way.
cards.flavor: "Wild magic requires both sound body and mind."

cards.name: Overgrown Creeper
cards.ruleText:
Guardian
{L}: Create {G}.
(Guardian — This card can't attack.)
cards.flavor: "It sucks the life out of all life around it, but just as much as it takes, it gives. Giving protection from those trying to enter The Grove." — Idrig

cards.name: Sable Tail Stinger
cards.ruleText:
Lethal
Arrive — Target Insect Character you control gains Lethal this turn.
(Lethal — Whenever this card deals damage to a Character, destroy that Character. Arrive — When this card is put on the Field, ...)

cards.name: Sapling Tender
cards.ruleText:
Coalesce — Put a +1 counter on another target Beast, Druid, or Plant Character.
(Coalesce — Whenever an Essence Arrives under your control, ...)
cards.flavor: "A kind touch."

cards.name: Fight Me!
cards.ruleText: Target Character you control Fights another target Character you don’t control.
cards.flavor: "Fight me!"

cards.name: Storm Maw
cards.ruleText:
Airborne, Overwhelm
(Airborne — This Character can only be blocked by other Characters with Airborne.)
cards.flavor: "If you feel the sky shake, run. If you hear its wings beat, flee. If you see its talons, you’re departing."

cards.name: The Corpseblossom
cards.ruleText:
Overwhelm, Intimidate, Gouge
Undead, Necro, and Plant Characters you control are Undead, Necro and Plant in addition to their other types.
You may pay {G} for each {I} or {V} in the cost of Undead, Necro, and Plant cards you play.

cards.name: Polychromatic Paradox
cards.ruleText: Cancel target card that shares a color with the colors of mana used to play this card.
cards.flavor: "Mystery in every hue." — Frelain

cards.name: Rabid Racoon
cards.ruleText:
Bloodlust, Intimidate, Swift
(Bloodlust — This Character must attack each Battle if able.)
(Swift — This Character can attack and activate Lock abilities the turn it's played.)

cards.name: Pick Clean
cards.ruleText:
Banish target Character in a Grave that was put there this turn.
Gain Life equal to that
card’s Mana Cost.
cards.flavor: "The cycle of life, even the mightiest return to the soil."

cards.name: Hollshire, Avid Researcher
cards.ruleText:
Thaumaturge
The first time each turn you play a Spell or Relic card that doesn’t share a name with a card in your Grave, Draw 1.

cards.name: Grips from Beyond
cards.ruleText:
Absolute
You control target opponent during their next turn.
Banish this card.
cards.flavor: "There was no deal to be made as I could use nothing it offered."

cards.name: Broken Fang Ronin
cards.ruleText:
Swift, Fury
Characters you control with Swift gain Fury.
cards.flavor: "He wanders the land in makeshift gangs, but his speed never falters."

cards.name: Ivory Field Watchmen
cards.ruleText:
Fortify, Steadfast
Characters you control with Fortify gain Steadfast.
cards.flavor: "Although slow, nothing ever got past his watch."

cards.name: Jet Prowler
cards.ruleText:
Snare, Lethal
Characters you control with Snare gain Lethal.
cards.flavor: "The black of his coat let him slip into the shadows, the only thing darker was the pools of blood he left behind."

cards.name: Bullfrog Bully
cards.ruleText:
Intimidate
Characters you control with Intimidate, gain Intimidate.
cards.flavor: "The boils on his skin reflected the horrified look of his victims."

cards.name: Magpie Magus
cards.ruleText:
Thaumaturge, Airborne
Characters you control with Thaumaturge gain Airborne.
cards.flavor: "He teaches magic to fly so they can see the magic of flying."

cards.name: Vow of Silence
cards.ruleText:
Imbue Character
Imbued Character gains Sustain and Shade.
cards.flavor: "Living in silence lets you hear the light."

cards.name: Mark of the Beast
cards.ruleText:
Imbue Character
Arrive — Remove all connected cards you don’t control from the Cursed card.
Cursed Character gains Bloodlust and becomes a Wild Beast in addition to its other types, and can’t be Armed.

cards.name: Wandering Rhinodon
cards.ruleText:
If you control an Ire Core Essence, this card gains +1 Attack.
If you control a Lux Core Essence, this card gains +1 Health.
cards.flavor: "He has few thoughts, but he still wants to see the world." — Idrig

cards.name: Celestial Colonnade
cards.ruleText:
Airborne
Whenever you gain Life,
each opponent loses 1 Life.
cards.flavor: "They watch over the stars, listening to their secrets."

cards.name: Ghoultouched Decant
cards.ruleText:
Lethal
Whenever a Character you control with Lethal destroys another Character, you may pay {X} where X is equal to the destroyed card’s Mana Cost. If you do, Revive that Character.

cards.name: Queen of the Sprites
cards.flavor: "A’Lis is the ruler of lesser and greater Fey, do not cross her."

cards.name: A'Lis the Glamour
cards.ruleText:
Airborne, Barrier {2}
The Base Attack and Health of Characters you control becomes 1, and they gain Airborne and Barrier {2}.
cards.flavor: "Fluttering and dancing in the breeze."

cards.name: Align Chakra
